description: This file defines the ClusterMember class, representing a member of a cluster in the Orleans runtime. It includes properties for silo address, status, and name, along with methods for equality comparison, hashing, and string representation.

classes.name: ClusterMember
classes.description: A class representing a cluster member with properties for address, status, and name, and methods for equality, hashing, and string conversion.

methods.name: ClusterMember
methods.description: Constructor initializing a new instance of ClusterMember with specified address, status, and name.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Determines whether this ClusterMember is equal to another object or ClusterMember.

methods.description: Returns a hash code based on the silo address.
